title: XOR Key-Gate Localization and Partial Key Recovery in a Locked Combinational Netlist

expected_outputs.summary: A single JSON file submission/recovered_key.json identifying key-controlled gate instances in the locked netlist, their gate types (XOR/XNOR/MUX/BUF/UNKNOWN), and a recovered (possibly partial, with 'x' for unresolved bits) key string consistent with the supplied oracle vectors.
